item.tib: sngon 'gro'i bon spyod rgyun khyer yan lag bdun pa
item.coloph: de ltar rgyun khyer nyams len sngon 'gro'i bon/ yan lag bdun pa 'phags pa'i nor mchog 'di/ ser tsha dge rgan bon spyod skal pa ru/ sa byi lo yi nag zla'i yar tshes kyi/ rgyal ba gsum par bya dur gnas kyi mdun/ sgar mal dgon du nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes/ nyul ba po des blo la gang shar bris/ nyes gyur bshags shing dge ba 'gro la bsngo/ lam 'dir zhugs rnams phyir mi ldog pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong rgyun du zhugs mchog gi g.yung drung sa la ma lus 'khod par shog dge'o//
